easy.def: In the air or seen from above.
examples: The bird did an aerial dance.
An aerial view of the town.

more.def: Happening in the air, or seen from high above, as from a plane or a bird.
examples: The aerial photo showed our whole town as tiny squares and lines.
The acrobat gave a daring aerial show on a swing high above the crowd.
An aerial view of the farm showed a green patchwork of fields.

more.def: Daring and skillful stunts done by a pilot, such as loops and rolls.

easy.def: Fast exercise to music that makes your heart beat quickly.

more.def: A kind of exercise, often done to music, that makes your heart and lungs work harder.
examples: We did aerobics to lively music in gym class.
Aerobics helps make your heart strong.
My aunt teaches an aerobics class.

more.def: The study of how planes fly.
examples: Aeronautics helps us build better planes.
She dreams of working in aeronautics.

more.def: A can containing liquid under pressure that comes out as a fine spray.
examples: The paint came in an aerosol can.
An aerosol sprays a fine mist.
She sprayed it from an aerosol.
